tools.name: countly_get_current_user
tools.description: Show the Countly dashboard user this API key belongs to: name, username, whether it is a global admin, and its permissions. Use it first to check the connection. Countly: GET /o/users/me.

tools.name: countly_list_apps
tools.description: List the apps this user can see, split into apps the user administers and apps the user can read. Each app has its ID, name, country and timezone. Countly: GET /o/apps/mine.

tools.name: countly_get_app
tools.description: Show one app's settings, owner, creation and last-data times, and its member lists. Needs app administrator rights for that app. Countly: GET /o/apps/details.

tools.name: countly_get_dashboard
tools.description: Summary cards for one app and period: total sessions, new users, total users, time spent and requests, each with its change against the previous period. Countly: GET /o/analytics/dashboard.

tools.name: countly_get_sessions
tools.description: Session timeline for one app and period: one row per day (or per month with bucket=monthly) with sessions, new users, total users, duration and events. Countly: GET /o/analytics/sessions.

tools.name: countly_get_countries
tools.description: Top countries for one app in fixed blocks: today, the last 7 days and the last 30 days, each with users, new users and sessions. Countly: GET /o/analytics/countries.

tools.name: countly_get_metric
tools.description: One breakdown list for one app and period, for example users by platform, device, screen resolution, carrier or app version. An unknown metric returns an empty list. Countly: GET /o/analytics/metric.

tools.name: countly_get_tops
tools.description: Top-ten lists for one app and period. Without metric it returns the built-in lists (platforms, versions, countries and more); with metric it returns that one list. Countly: GET /o/analytics/tops.

tools.name: countly_get_loyalty
tools.description: How often users return in one app and period: the share of users per session-count bucket. Countly: GET /o/analytics/loyalty.
